data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word ‘mahast’, meaning ‘blessed’ or ‘fortunate’. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that this name is a source of blessings and good fortune for the child. The name Mahasti carries the meaning “Blessed, Fortunate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mahasti usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed, fortunate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
